name: lingua-x402-mcp
description: Pay-per-call language detection and verification (x402, USDC/Solana) — no account or API key required.
long_description: MCP server exposing Lingua Detective's paid APIs with per-call x402 payments (USDC on Solana, gas sponsored). Four tools: detect_langue ($0.002), verifier_langue ($0.004), bundle_check ($0.006), and credit_topup (flexible amount). Two payment modes: payer wallet (X402_PAYER_KEY_B64) or prepaid credit (X402_CREDIT_TOKEN).
